food.nri_angle: A make-ahead, shippable Diwali savoury for diaspora kitchens: one batch covers guests, gift jars and the tea tin, and keeps crisp for up to two weeks airtight.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

steps: Add thin poha in a wide pan. Dry roast on low flame till it is crisp. Keep it aside.
In the same pan heat oil. Add peanuts and roast till crisp.
Add cashew, roasted gram dal, dry coconut slices and roast for 3-4 minutes.
Then add raisin and roast till the raisins puff up. Keep the nuts aside.
In the same pan add mustard seeds and let it crackle.
Add green chili, curry leaves and saute till crisp and dry. Then add hing, turmeric, red chili powder, roasted nuts and mix well.
Now add nuts mixture to roasted poha along with salt, powdered sugar, aamchur powder and mix everything well.
Cool completely before storing; store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

carousel.image_caption: Andrew Ng at WSJ CIO Dinner on AI. AI pioneer Andrew Ng offered the counter-case at the NDTV World Summit on October 22: US software engineer postings are up because AI makes engineers more productive, and reskilling, not exit, is the answer.
carousel.image_credit: Photo: Steve Jurvetson via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0)
carousel.nri_angle: For Indian IT professionals in India and the US diaspora, the data points to reskilling toward AI deployment, security and architecture rather than exiting the profession.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Gold Retreats From Record Highs as Jewellers Bet on Diwali Demand
carousel.excerpt: Prices are down nearly 20% from the January record to Rs 14,315 per gram, but IBJA expects October volumes to fall 11% year on year as lightweight designs and old-gold exchange sustain value sales ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali.
carousel.nri_angle: Gold buying for Dhanteras and Diwali is a shared ritual for diaspora families, and the price correction affects both jewellery budgets and remittance-season purchases.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
